cases.statement: Audit logs are retained for 90 days.
supports: The retention policy keeps audit logs for 90 days.

cases.statement: Gold tier failover RPO is 15 minutes.
supports: Gold tier failover has an RPO of 15 minutes.
Manager approval is required for requests.
All exports use encryption while stored.
Backups are scheduled each six hours.
Deleted accounts remain subject to the retention policy.
